


|| STEP ONE ||

To install:

Place "CompAcademy" folder and "CA_QualifierWidget.py" in your /.Nuke/ directory.


|| STEP TWO ||

Paste these lines into your "init.py" located in your /.Nuke/ directory.  If it doesn't exist, create one.

# Compositing Academy Tools
nuke.pluginAddPath('./CompAcademy')
nuke.pluginAddPath('./CompAcademy/icons')
nuke.pluginAddPath('./CompAcademy/tools')
nuke.pluginAddPath('./CompAcademy/graphics')

|| STEP THREE ||

Paste these lines into your "menu.py" located in your /.Nuke/ directory.  If it doesn't exist, create one.

# Compositing Academy Tools
import CA_QualifierWidget
toolbar = nuke.toolbar("Nodes")
m = toolbar.addMenu("Compositing Academy", icon="qf_logo.png")
m.addCommand("CA_HueQualifier", "nuke.createNode('CA_HueQualifier')", icon="qf_logo.png")
